findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_records, list_companies, get_filings_wire, create_board, get_organization_record, list_feed_sources, get_feed_events, explain_record · Private data: search_records, get_record, list_companies, get_company, get_filings_wire, get_coverage, answer, graph_neighborhood, who_is_behind, create_board, pilot02_follow_the_money, search_organizations, get_organization_record, screen_organizations, get_whats_moving, list_feed_sources, get_feed_events, what_changed_since, explain_record · Public sink: search_records, answer, get_feed_events, what_changed_since · Destructive: get_company_profile, list_feed_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_records, list_companies, get_filings_wire, create_board, get_organization_record, list_feed_sources, get_feed_events, explain_record · Private data: search_records, get_record, list_companies, get_company, get_filings_wire, get_coverage, answer, graph_neighborhood, who_is_behind, create_board, pilot02_follow_the_money, search_organizations, get_organization_record, screen_organizations, get_whats_moving, list_feed_sources, get_feed_events, what_changed_since, explain_record · Public sink: search_records, answer, get_feed_events, what_changed_since · Destructive: get_company_profile, list_feed_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_records" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
